name: Protocol Breakdown
summary: This game uses Gorilla Tag–style locomotion and gives you a mix of different things to do. You can explore spooky forests, tunnels, and caves, or just relax in chill areas like gyms and open hangout spaces. There are puzzles to solve, minigames to complete, and items to collect and sell for rewards. You can swim through hidden areas, chop down trees, and work through adventure and horror challenges to unlock secrets and prizes.
